Test of the "function end names" inlay hint (#80465).

-- settings.json --
{"hints": {"functionEndNames": true}, "analyses": {"unusedfunc": false}}

-- p/p.go --
package p //@inlayhints(out)

type T struct{}

func foo() {
	_ = func() {}
}

func (T) method() {}

func (*T) pointerMethod() {}

func generic[T any](v T) {}

func 日本語() {}

func bodyless()
-- @out --
package p //@inlayhints(out)

type T struct{}

func foo() {
	_ = func() {}
}< // foo>

func (T) method() {}< // method>

func (*T) pointerMethod() {}< // pointerMethod>

func generic[T any](v T) {}< // generic>

func 日本語() {}< // 日本語>

func bodyless()
